quote: Shenzhen Kaifa Technology (Chengdu) Co., Ltd. (Stock Code: 920029) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved an outbound investment of approximately RMB 284 million (approximately USD 40 million). The investment includes a capital increase to its wholly-owned Brazilian subsidiary, Intelligent Energy Metering Brazil Ltda., as well as the establishment of a localized production plant in the Manaus Free Trade Zone, Amazonas, Brazil.
note: Opened KAIFA English company release (dated 7 Nov 2025 in body; page stamp 2025.11.10).
